defects.factual_basis: ST 0601.14-32, §6.5: 'Required items of a UAS Datalink LS (Tag 1 - Checksum, Tag 2 - Precision Time Stamp, and Tag 65 - UAS Datalink LS Version Number) instance shall always be reported with positive lengths (i.e. Zero-Length Items (ZLI) are not allowed for these items).' A ZLI on one of those three is the one zero-length case the document itself makes a defect
